method: Independent review of the new first-launch/Workbench symptom table and failure-report guidance against actual owner, input and provider source. The retained physics table is not requalified.
observations: Launcher exact-version/LFS checks are real; script import does not supply missing native APIs.

Save polls completion then rechecks native fences. It may save settled authored data after a failed owner, but rejects unconfirmed legacy brush execution. The table preserves that conditional boundary and directs restart plus Load.
Flatten is material-only and explicitly refuses a failed native owner. Queued drawing and partial Stop results are not described as completed or safely replayable.

Art close/hide is separate from stop_all; session-only _ensure_history_loaded does not reopen prior chat. Redaction cannot make all prompts, endpoints or scene content public, so minimal safe diagnostics are appropriate.
Actor/input and incomplete-package symptoms route to current canonical guides without promising generic model control, feature parity or evaluator acceptance.
limitations: Source review only. No model/provider request, interactive recovery reproduction or new physical/runtime qualification.
The review does not certify every unchanged physics symptom row.
